text:
sahil: FYI seeing a spike in 503s during spot reclaims in us-west-2 this morning. started ~08:12 UTC.

infra-bot: Preemptible reclaim notice: node-gpu-7b scheduled termination in 120s (reason: spot-preempt)

olivia: ...and that node was serving a lot of streaming sessions. we're observing token cutover failures — clients don't requeue cleanly.

joel: is this the stitch case where kv-cache lost prefixes? we've seen partial KV sync cause 400/resume errors.

sahil: looks like when the container gets SIGTERM we immediately close socket. need graceful drain to stream token bridge.

maria: cost note: adding 10% on-demand standby increases monthly spend ~$6k but reduces failed requests by ~90% in sim.

karen: can we do a soft-cutover: extend preemptible grace window, start token-streaming proxy that holds tokens in mem, then handoff?

olivia: sketch of handshake:
```
proxy: on reclaim -> mark node DRAINING, start stream-proxy on standby
runtime: flush KV prefix to proxy, continue serving, notify LB to shift new sessions
proxy: replay KV prefixes, stitch client token stream
```

joel: also need idempotent resume token format. suggest include node-id + seq + checksum so proxy can dedupe.

sahil: agree. we should also requeue in-flight requests instead of dropping: client->runtime returns 202 + requeue-id.

infra-bot: reclaim escalated: node-gpu-7b terminated at 08:15:03 UTC

maria: proposal: run a 2-week canary in us-west-2: 3% traffic to mixed-pool with proxy, 97% baseline. track p99 latency, requeues/min, failed streams.

karen: rollback plan? if tail latency > +50ms for 3 consecutive windows we revert via routing policy.

olivia: experiment metrics: requeue-success-rate, requeue-latency, resume-consistency, cost-delta. define dashboards and alerts.

joel: quick config snippet for resume token format:
`resume_token = f"{node_id}:{seq}:{crc32(payload)}"`

sahil: action items: olivia implement proxy prototype, joel add dedupe/format, maria calc cost windows and run canary, karen own rollback triggers. I'll schedule standup sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

olivia: will open PR with prototype and test harness.

maria: running numbers now, will post in thread.

karen: thanks team :thumbsup:
